title: Design System: Battle Pass ROI Calculator

display.purpose: The verdict word, fit to the main column (46-176px by script).

chapter-title.purpose: Chapter plate titles; wdth widens 52 to 125 on scroll.

title.purpose: Sub-heads and the stat block head.

sentence.purpose: The sentence-form input line; inputs at 800.

lede.purpose: Chapter deks and the verdict sentence.

table.purpose: Stat block and data tables, tabular lining figures.

shadows.name: ink-ring
shadows.purpose: Ghost button outline without layout shift.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Ruler marker labels; 1px variants keyline paper and black tabs.

shadows.name: misregistration-flash
shadows.purpose: Transient text-shadow keyframe (420ms to zero) when a figure changes; never at rest.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default curve (GSAP expo.out): entrances, rolls, tab slides, presses.

motion.name: ease-io
motion.purpose: Plate travel and trims (GSAP expo.inOut): press-check registration, sheet trim, sticker strike.

motion.name: press-check
motion.purpose: Crop marks and registration targets draw, Y/C/M plates slide 1.3s into register while wdth widens to 150, black prints, sheet trims upward via clip-path.

motion.name: verdict-reprint
motion.purpose: Cyan and magenta copies of the verdict slip back into register while letters rise from line masks (0.028s stagger).

motion.name: number-roll
motion.purpose: Changed figures count to their new value with the C/M flash.

motion.name: highlighter-swipe
motion.purpose: Marker scales in from the left under the reader's inputs.

motion.name: plate-wipe
motion.purpose: Chapter plates wipe in from alternating sides; titles widen wdth 52 to 125.

motion.name: walkthrough-pin
motion.purpose: At 900px+ wide and 720px+ tall the stage pins and scroll plays the season week by week.

motion.name: ledger-print
motion.purpose: Ledger and stat rows print left to right via clip-path.

motion.name: tile-flip
motion.purpose: Item tiles flip in on rotateY.

motion.name: flip-rerank
motion.purpose: Bestiary entries re-rank by threat with a FLIP translate.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No press check, Lenis, pins or scroll scenes; highlighters pre-swiped, halftones drawn complete, numbers set instantly, CSS transitions 0.01ms.

narrative.overview:
The system is a printed strategy guide for the reader's own playtime: coated cool-white stock run through a four-color press. Cyan, magenta and rich black are not accents; each one owns a whole chapter as a full-bleed plate, and where two inks meet they overprint by multiply, exactly as wet ink would. Crop marks, registration targets, color control strips and halftone dot ramps are the printer's furniture, and they stay visible because they are the world, not decoration on top of it.

Density is a guidebook's density: enormous extended display words set against tight ruled stat tables in tabular figures. Scale courage carries the hierarchy; a single verdict word fits the full width of its column while the numbers beside it sit at table size. One fluorescent spot ink, the highlighter, marks only what is in the reader's hand: their inputs, their edits, their selection. Every figure carries a provenance tag (yours, est., derived) so no estimate passes as fact, and every state prints itself as a sentence in the guide's voice instead of as a pill or badge.

The world refuses the category default of a dark neon gaming dashboard with glass cards and gradient headings. Motion is a press run: plates slide into register, misregister when a figure changes, and snap back on an exponential ease-out.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, rich-black ink, process cyan and magenta as chapter plates.
Multiply overprint wherever two inks meet, at rest and in motion.
Anybody 900 uppercase on a live width axis for display; Archivo with tabular figures for text and tables.
Ruled tables, hairline and heavy rules, almost no containers.
Highlighter yellow-green reserved for the reader's own numbers.
One 12-column grid that tabs, tables and plates all snap to.

rules.name: The Chapter Plate Rule
rules.body: Each chapter owns exactly one ink as a full-bleed plate: cyan for the Walkthrough, magenta for Shop Math, rich black for the Bestiary, paper shade for the Appendix. The same ink colors that chapter's thumb tab. A new chapter takes a plate; it does not invent a fifth ink.

rules.name: The Overprint Rule
rules.body: Where two inks meet they multiply (`mix-blend-mode: multiply`), never stack opaquely: thumb tabs overlap and overprint each other, the magenta season wall overprints the cyan trail, the press-check plates overprint into the title.

rules.name: The Reader's Ink Rule
rules.body: The highlighter marks only what the reader controls or has entered. A figure the guide derived or estimated never gets it, no matter how important.

rules.name: The Press Furniture Rule
rules.body: Process Yellow and the extra control-strip patches (the blue, red, green and gray swatches of the colophon color bar) live only in the press-check opening and the color control strips. They are never used as interface color.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Display hierarchy is tuned on `wdth`, not just size: titles rest at 125, buttons at 115, tabs at 112, compact mobile tabs at 74, the press-check word at 150. Motion animates `wdth`; it never fakes width with scale.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number column and every changing figure uses tabular lining figures, so values can roll in place without the column jittering.

rules.name: The Ink Not Light Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from ink layering and rules, never from light. A surface that needs to feel separate gets a plate, a rule, or an overprint, not a shadow.

dos: **Do** give each chapter one process ink as a full-bleed plate and the matching thumb tab (cyan walkthrough, magenta shop math, rich black bestiary, paper shade appendix).
**Do** multiply wherever two inks meet: overlapping tabs, the wall over the trail, plates in register.
**Do** tag every figure with its provenance: `yours`, `est.`, or `derived`.
**Do** reserve the highlighter (#e8ff3a) for what the reader controls or has entered.
**Do** set magenta text in Magenta Text Ink (#c4006b) and white only on the magenta plate.
**Do** set every number in tabular lining figures and let changed numbers roll and misregister.
**Do** snap every new block to the 12-column grid inside `.wrap`, keeping the 46px tab reserve from 900px up.
**Do** separate with rules (1px hairline, 3px, 7px, double) rather than boxes.
**Do** design the reduced-motion state as a finished still page.
donts: **Don't** build the dark neon gaming dashboard: no glass cards, no glows, no gradient headings or gradient text.
**Don't** put a small uppercase eyebrow or kicker above headings; uppercase micro-type is for provenance tags and table column heads only.
**Don't** print states as pills or badges; print them as sentences in the guide's voice.
**Don't** use the highlighter on derived or estimated figures, or as a general accent.
**Don't** use Process Yellow or the control-strip patches outside the press check and color bars.
**Don't** add drop or ambient shadows; depth is ink, rule and overprint.
**Don't** introduce a fifth ink or a second display face.
**Don't** use publisher logos, game art or trade dress.
